title: Day 130: Iranian Strikes Hit 4 Vessels in Strait of Hormuz — Al Rekayyat, Wedyan, Cyprus Prosperity, Kiku — MOU Strained
detail: Iranian projectile and drone strikes hit four vessels in the Strait of Hormuz: LNG tanker Al Rekayyat caught fire and was abandoned; oil tanker Wedyan was drone-damaged; container ship Cyprus Prosperity suffered minor damage; oil tanker Kiku's bridge was damaged in a repeat attack. CENTCOM conducted retaliatory airstrikes on Iranian military and communications sites near the strait. The attack wave placed severe strain on the June 17 Islamabad Memorandum's 60-day safe-passage guarantee.

media.caption: 2026 Strait of Hormuz crisis — four vessels struck July 6-7
